title: A space-only step on a pump with no heating-only mode charges a cold tank: the DHW gate is floored at 30 C
claim: With a mode select offering only Heating + DHW (GCHV), a step booking f kW of space heat and no hot water writes the tank set-point 30 C over a 20 C tank whose start hysteresis is 5 K, so the pump is asked to charge the tank on a step the plan booked none: 2 of 2 such rigs.
mechanism: pump_arbiter.desired, space row with no Heating option: dhw_setpoint = _bounded(DHW_GATE_C=30, rounding down) — the entity's minimum but never below 30 C, independent of the tank reading; the hot-water entity in the rig accepts down to 10 C. A tank under 30 C less the pump's own hysteresis starts charging under Heating + DHW.

evidence.unit: rigs (gchv-flow, gchv-indoor) where min-cold-tank asks the tank to charge
evidence.machine: box B11, Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, venv-ci CPython 3.14
evidence.contention_note: count; contention-immune (two other seats on the box)

metric_definition: Rigs whose min-cold-tank row reads mode in {DHW, Heating+DHW} and tank set-point minus the pump's hysteresis above the tank reading after the step's writes.
phenomenon_property: On a step the plan books no hot water, the pump is never left with a tank set-point its own thermostat would start a charge on, where the entity's range allows a lower one.

null_control.note: the same gchv rigs at partial/full with the tank at 48 C: the 30 C gate asks no charge (rows ok); and the fork rigs at min-cold-tank, where the Heating mode gates the tank: rows ok

proposed_fix_scope: pump_arbiter.desired's single-mode-less space row: gate the tank at the entity's minimum (or below the tank reading less the read hysteresis), not a fixed 30 C floor; doc table and strings.json follow.
